description: Follow team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules (docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-delegation/DELEGATION.md lines 8-20) and the approved plan docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-cheap-fixes/PLAN.md; the task section named here is the spec (files, steps, acceptance check, fail-first, stop rules). Pinned Node; serial check slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) before expensive checks; production-preview Playwright on a free port 1500+; no installs/commits/pushes; register any extra path before editing; report CLAIMED with log paths; independent review required. Plan task T6: add optional suffix to SourceCreator (src/research/types.ts:2), carry it in src/research/cslImport.ts:70-77, format in src/research/citations.ts (note form 'John Q. Smith Jr.', bibliography 'Smith, John Q., Jr.'); tests in bibtexImport.test.ts and citations.test.ts; creators without suffix format byte-identically; check store.rs creator validation for an allowlist first (stop rule).

handoff.text: REJECT (reviewer agent-09a9). Good: diff limited to the 5 registered files; suffix optional/additive in types.ts, carried from CSL in cslImport.ts; no src-tauri change, no deletions. My runs (pinned Node v22.23.3, logs in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-cf6-review/): targeted citations+bibtexImport 35/35; fail-first vs HEAD sources 2 failed/33 passed; npx vitest run src/research 188 pass, 4 fail all in zotero.test.ts pagination + 3 tsc errors in zotero.ts (live T056, not counted). Cargo store cited from worker log (22 passed, 1 ignored), slot was held by T052. DEFECT: src/research/citations.ts bibliography prints 'Smith, John Q., Jr.. Title. Press, 2020.' (double period), visible output introduced by printing the suffix. Cause: author block joined with '. ' at citations.ts:271 (a + (bib ? '. ' : ', ')) and the bib displayName joins at ~162, 176, 199, 221 (`${displayName}. `). Reproduce: from project root with pinned Node, npx vitest run --root node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-cf6-review/repro src/research/doublePeriod.test.ts (expects 'Smith, John Q., Jr. Title. Press, 2020.'; currently 1 failed). Also note: your first fail-first (team-cf6/failfirst.log) showed the no-suffix case given 'John Q.' giving 'Smith, John Q.. Title', and the fixture was then changed to 'John Quincy' -- the byte-identical test was steered away from the period case. REQUIRED FIX: when the bibliography author block already ends with '.', do not add another period (so 'Jr.' and 'John Q.' both end the author block with a single period); no other output change. The pre-existing 'John Q..' case is fixed by the same rule and that is acceptable. TESTS: fail-first (show failing on current code) for both suffix 'Jr.' bibliography and no-suffix given 'John Q.' bibliography expecting 'Smith, John Q. Title. Press, 2020.'; keep unchanged exact snapshots for names not ending in a period ('John Quincy', 'Charles Yu', full/short/bibliography). Done means: targeted vitest citations+bibtexImport all pass; repro command above passes; npx vitest run src/research passes except failures attributable to a still-live T056.
